tasks.name: cat_eats_fish
tasks.prompt: A lively anime illustration featuring both characters from the two reference images together in one scene. On the left, the playful cyber cat-girl with heterochromia eyes (pink and golden) and blue-purple four-pointed star hairpins is pouncing forward with an excited grin, playfully chomping at the single huge blue whale tail of the blue-haired maid girl on the right. The blue-haired whale maid girl wears her blue-and-white maid outfit with the small blue whale apron pattern, looking surprised and flustered. Only one whale tail. Cohesive vibrant 2D anime art style, clean lineart, dynamic comedic interaction.

tasks.name: fish_rides_dragon
tasks.prompt: An epic vibrant anime illustration combining both characters from the two reference images in the sky above fluffy clouds. The blue-haired whale maid girl with her large blue whale tail and maid apron is cheerfully riding piggyback on the back of the regal pure-white dragon girl who is flying in mid-air. The white dragon girl has white dragon horns, large white dragon wings spread wide in flight, a scaly white dragon tail, and wears her sleek white slit dress with black trim. A cute little blue cloud with eyes floats beside them. Cohesive 2D anime illustration, crisp details, bright sky, dynamic sense of flying.
